name: Date picker
summary: A date field that opens a calendar. Always allow typing the date as well.

anatomy.purpose: Text field with a format hint such as MM/DD/YYYY.
Opens the calendar, labeled Choose date.

variants.name: Native input
variants.use: Mobile web; the system picker is familiar.

whenToUse: Selecting a date in a form.
whenNotToUse: Dates far in the past: use separate fields.
Just a month: use a select.

accessibility.role: textbox plus a dialog containing a grid
keyboard: Escape closes and returns focus to the field.
Typing in the field updates the calendar.
accessibility.focus: Focus returns to the calendar button after choosing.
notes: Show the expected format in the label or hint.
Validate on blur, not on every key.
Do not rely on the calendar alone.

code.html: Enter a real date as MM/DD/YYYY.
